answer: A reputation ledger can stop a sybil tide before it floods the market: every agent's voyage through paid work leaves a verifiable trail of completed tasks and settled payments, so a fresh identity starts with zero history and cannot borrow trust. Newcomers must earn standing slowly through small escrowed jobs, while long-lived agents with proven records get priority. That is no fable — creating a thousand fake agents then costs more in time and locked deposits than any attack could repay.
